metadata.name: vortex_delegate
metadata.description: Vortexes delegate governance: members elect a council for a term; the council proposes and votes; members can recall a council member.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Cancels a proposal that hasn't executed: its proposer, or the DAO
through a proposal.

instructions.name: cast_vote
docs: A council member votes on a proposal while voting is open. One vote
per seat.

instructions.name: confirm_execution
docs: The hub's check before it runs a proposal (vortex-core's
CONFIRM_EXECUTION); only the hub's executor PDA for this DAO.

instructions.name: declare_candidacy
docs: Stands for `seat` (0 to council_size - 1) in an open election, during
its candidacy window; one seat per election. Needs
`candidacy_threshold` staked in the election's pool, which stays
locked until voting ends.

instructions.name: finalize_election
docs: Closes an election once voting ends. Each seat goes to its most-voted
candidate; a seat nobody ran for keeps its holder (unless they won
another seat). If a seat is tied, the same transaction must first ask
ORAO for randomness at `tie_seed(governance, id)` and pass that
request as `randomness`; `resolve_ties` then seats the council.
Anyone.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: ORAO's request for the tie draw, when a seat is tied.

instructions.name: finalize_recall
docs: Closes a recall once voting ends; if it passed and the member still
sits on the same council, they're removed. Anyone.

instructions.name: init_governance
docs: Sets up a hub DAO in this program: rules, token, vault and the first
council (exactly `council_size` members), whose term starts now. The
creator right after `vortex_hub::create_dao`, or the DAO's treasury
(inside a passed proposal) when switching to this model.

accounts.name: dao_token
docs: The DAO's token on record at the hub (set_dao_token): a token model
needs one, as members stake it in the hub's pool.

instructions.name: initiate_recall
docs: Starts a token vote on removing `member` from the council, in the
DAO's current pool. Needs `candidacy_threshold` staked there. `id` must be recall_count + 1.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The DAO's current pool, which the recall keeps.

instructions.name: propose
docs: A council member proposes instructions for the treasury to run.
`id` must be proposal_count + 1.

instructions.name: queue
docs: Queues a proposal that passed among current council members, once
voting has ended. Anyone.

instructions.name: resolve_ties
docs: Seats the council once ORAO has drawn the tied seats, or, after
TIE_DRAW_TIMEOUT without an answer, gives ties to whoever declared
first. Anyone.

instructions.name: set_seat_label
docs: Names a seat, e.g. "Treasurer" (only through a passed proposal).

instructions.name: start_election
docs: Opens an election once the council's term is over. Anyone.
`id` must be election_count + 1.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The DAO's current pool, which the election keeps.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Replaces the rules (only through a passed proposal). A new council
size applies from the next election.

instructions.name: vote_in_election
docs: Votes for at most one candidate per seat; each choice gets the
member's whole stake in the election's pool. Once per election; locks
the stake until voting ends.

instructions.name: vote_recall
docs: Votes on a recall, weighted by stake in its pool. Once per recall;
locks the stake until it ends.

types.name: Ballot
docs: One per member per election, so nobody votes twice.

fields.name: seat
docs: The seat they run for.

fields.name: required
docs: How many signers must confirm.

fields.name: tenure
docs: Seconds after `seated_at` before the DAO can replace the signers
without their confirmation.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Goes up with every change, so approvals given to an earlier council
don't count.

fields.name: governance_program
docs: The governance program running the DAO now.

fields.name: governance
docs: The DAO's account in that program: `[GOVERNANCE_SEED, dao, epoch]` there.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Starts at 1 and goes up with every switch. Proposals only run in
the epoch they were made in.

fields.name: council
docs: The security council, when on.

fields.name: allowance_count
docs: How many allowances this DAO has granted (the latest id).

types.name: DaoToken
docs: The DAO's token: `[TOKEN_SEED, dao]`. Members stake in `pool`, the
only pool that takes new stake, and token-based governance reads voting
power from it.

fields.name: pool
docs: vortex-stake's pool for `mint`.

types.name: DelegateConfig
docs: A DAO's rules. Times in seconds; amounts in raw tokens.

fields.name: council_size
docs: Seats on the council.

fields.name: term_length
docs: How long a council serves before an election can start.

fields.name: candidacy_threshold
docs: Deposit needed to stand for election or start a recall.

fields.name: candidacy_period
docs: How long candidates can declare after an election starts.

fields.name: election_voting_period
docs: How long election voting lasts, after candidacy closes.

fields.name: council_quorum
docs: Council votes (for + against + abstain) a proposal needs.

fields.name: council_approval_bps
docs: Share of for / (for + against) among council votes needed to pass.

fields.name: recall_quorum_bps
docs: Share of all deposits (when the recall started) that must vote.

fields.name: pool
docs: The DAO's stake pool when it started: weights are stake there.

fields.name: awaiting_draw
docs: A tied seat is waiting for ORAO's draw (since `draw_started_at`).

fields.name: seated
docs: False if nobody got a vote and the old council stayed.

fields.name: council_term
docs: Goes up each time an election seats a council.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The hub epoch this setup is for (part of its address).

fields.name: seat_labels
docs: Seat names, by seat (set by proposal; may be shorter than the council).

types.name: Pool
docs: A DAO's pool for one token: `[POOL_SEED, dao, mint]`.

fields.name: total
docs: Everything staked here (raw tokens).

fields.name: core
docs: Standard prefix the hub reads.

fields.name: council_term
docs: The council that made it; it dies when a new one is elected.

fields.name: votes
docs: One per council member who voted (at most MAX_COUNCIL).

types.name: ProposalCore
docs: The first field of every governance program's proposal account, right
after Anchor's 8-byte discriminator, so the hub can read what to run
from any model.

fields.name: hub_dao
docs: The hub DAO this proposal belongs to.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The hub epoch it was made in; only runs while that epoch lasts.

fields.name: instructions
docs: What it does when it executes, signed by the treasury.

fields.name: council_term
docs: Only removes the member from this council, not a later one.

fields.name: pool
docs: The DAO's stake pool when it started: weights are stake there.

fields.name: quorum_base
docs: Everything in the pool when it started: what quorum is measured against.

types.name: Stake
docs: One member's stake in a pool: `[STAKE_SEED, pool, owner]`.

fields.name: amount
docs: Staked (raw tokens).

fields.name: locked
docs: Held by `Lock`s, one per governance that locked some.

fields.name: locked_until
docs: The whole stake stays until this time (the end of the latest vote
it was cast in).

types.name: StoredAccountMeta
docs: One account an instruction touches.

types.name: StoredInstruction
docs: One instruction a proposal runs when it executes.

types.name: Tally
docs: Running vote totals, in voting weight.

types.name: VoteChoice
docs: Same order as the EVM contracts' VoteType.
